mapping_basis.rule: Keep official page order, merge only short setup/bridge/tail pages, and keep substantial text-only pages as separate chapters.

included_pages.title: Introduction to Computational Neuroscience with Neuroblox

chapters.coverage_reason: course_home is the course overview and getting_started is short environment setup. Combining them avoids fragmenting the book before the actual modeling chapters begin.
This page is short but self-contained, has its own lecture video, and anchors the programming-language layer used by the rest of the course.

chapters.chapter_title: ModelingToolkit 与微分方程（Differential Equations with ModelingToolkit）
chapters.coverage_reason: This is a dense, code-heavy lesson with multiple worked subsections, figures, and challenge problems; it should stand alone.
Although text-only, the page is substantial enough to justify its own chapter because it introduces the plotting stack that the rest of the course reuses.

chapters.chapter_title: Neuroblox 基础对象与电路组装（Blox and Connections in Neuroblox）
chapters.coverage_reason: blox_connections defines blox, connections, custom blox, and callbacks; circuits is a short bridge page that naturally closes the same conceptual block.

chapters.chapter_title: 神经元、神经质量与外部输入源（Neurons, Neural Masses and Sources）
chapters.coverage_reason: This is a large conceptual block with multiple modeling primitives and an application to deep brain stimulation, so it should remain a standalone chapter.

chapters.chapter_title: 皮层-纹状体微集群模型（Biomimetic Model of Corticostriatal Micro-assemblies）
chapters.coverage_reason: The page is a distinct, figure-rich case study and should be kept as a separate chapter rather than folded into the generic circuit material.

chapters.chapter_title: PING 振荡网络（Pyramidal-Interneuron Gamma network）
chapters.coverage_reason: This page is another canonical network model with its own literature trail and simulation workflow, so it deserves its own chapter.

chapters.chapter_title: 电路中的决策模型（Decision Making in a Circuit Model）

included_pages.title: Decision Making in a Circuit Model

chapters.coverage_reason: The page introduces a distinct dynamical decision-making model and should not be flattened into the nearby case-study chapters.

chapters.chapter_title: 突触可塑性与强化学习（Synaptic Plasticity and Reinforcement Learning）
chapters.coverage_reason: This page is substantial and methodologically distinct, so it should be a dedicated chapter.

chapters.chapter_title: 参数拟合：优化（Parameter Fitting using Optimization）
chapters.coverage_reason: This is the first model-fitting chapter and has enough worked material, equations, and references to stand alone.

chapters.chapter_title: Spectral DCM、模型推断与实验设计（Parameter Fitting using Spectral Dynamic Causal Modeling）

included_pages.title: Parameter Fitting using Spectral Dynamic Causal Modeling

chapters.coverage_reason: DCM is the substantive capstone methods page; experimental_design is very short and works best as the closing tail section rather than a standalone chapter.

notes: Every official unit page is mapped exactly once.
The only merges are the front matter, the short Neuroblox bridge page after blox_connections, and the short experimental_design tail after DCM.
uncertainties: No source states an official lecture-to-page numbering, so this chapter map is inferred from official page order and topical scope.
The chapter map deliberately prefers readability over one-page-per-chapter for the obvious short bridge/tail pages.
